first.rationale: Targeted pricing is the most direct response to the immediate competitive loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts and has prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift. A small, segment-limited test protects long-term qualified revenue from discounting or low-quality acquisition risk. I am also verifying the onboarding evidence because declining onboarding completion and activation may offer a higher-sustainability alternative if the archived records show stronger qualified-revenue effects.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying and shortening onboarding. The verified record shows higher completion (+13%), faster time-to-value (2.1 days), and improved 30-day retention (+3%), directly addressing the current declines in onboarding completion and activation while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Do not use promotional pricing: its verified qualified-revenue lift came with a 12% 30-day retention decline and was explicitly not sustainable. Guard against reduced lead/account qualification or loss of essential setup data.
